_meta.description: Consumable in-app purchases (trivia hint packs) for App Store Connect and Google Play Console. Copy is derived from the in-app hint-store strings in src/i18n/translations.ts so the store listing and the sheet say the same thing.
_meta.sourceOfTruth: src/config/app.ts -> HINT_PACKS.HINTS_BY_PRODUCT (product ids + hint counts must match exactly)
notes: en-US / es-419 are the default locales in each console; every other locale falls back to them, so those two must always be filled in.
Apple rejects display names or descriptions that contain a price, a discount claim, or the word free. Keep the value framing (BEST VALUE badge) inside the app only.
Product ids are permanent. Apple never allows reuse of an id, Google never allows reuse of a deleted one.

android.priceConversion: Auto-convert from the USD default price to all other markets

products.reviewNote: Consumable hint pack for the in-app trivia quizzes. Path to the purchase: launch the app, open the Trivia tab in the bottom bar, then tap the hint balance pill on the Game Modes row to open the Hint Store sheet (the same sheet also opens from the Get Hints pill during a game). Select the 20 pack and tap the buy button. Hints are credited to an on-device balance, never expire, and are spent one at a time to reveal a clue on a trivia question. No account or login is required, and no other purchase is needed to reach this screen.

android.description: 20 pistas para los cuestionarios de trivia. Revela una pista cuando una pregunta te tenga atascado. Las pistas nunca caducan y sirven en todos los modos de trivia.

android.description: 20 indices pour les quiz. Révèle un indice quand une question vous bloque. Les indices n'expirent jamais et fonctionnent dans tous les modes de quiz.
